policy.attribution: Attribution is the default, not the exception. Every credit below must render VISIBLY on the page. Hiding a credit behind a hover or an 'info' affordance is a licence violation for every asset with attribution_required = true.
policy.sharealike: OPEN DECISION 2 decided 2026-07-25 -> option (a). No fixed derivative work is created: served assets are the unmodified Commons file or a Commons-generated mechanical resize of it, and the PlayerMark treatment is applied in CSS at render time. The ShareAlike obligation on derivatives is therefore never triggered.
policy.photo_source: Wikimedia Commons only. No press photography, no team media.
